acceptance: New file claude_sdk_map.rs exposes exactly `pub fn map_sdk_message(message: &Value, session_id: &str) -> PiRpcMapping` (std + serde_json + the ACP schema only; one explanatory `#![allow(dead_code)]` at the top like pi_rpc_map.rs, with a comment that the Claude client packet removes it). The mapping is total: any value, including non-objects and missing fields, returns an empty mapping and never panics; the file stays under 350 lines

RULES. (0) If the message has a non-null `parent_tool_use_id` return an empty mapping (sub-agent traffic is a known gap; add a `// ponytail:` comment). (1) stream_event/content_block_delta: delta.type text_delta with non-empty text -> SessionUpdate::AgentMessageChunk; delta.type thinking_delta with non-empty `thinking` -> SessionUpdate::AgentThoughtChunk; other deltas -> nothing. (2) stream_event/content_block_start with content_block.type tool_use -> SessionUpdate::ToolCall::new(<id>, <name>) with kind chosen from the tool name (Bash -> Execute; Read -> Read; Write, Edit, MultiEdit, NotebookEdit -> Edit; Glob, Grep -> Search; WebFetch, WebSearch -> Fetch; everything else -> Other), status InProgress, raw_input = the block's input. (3) assistant messages: for each content block of type tool_use emit a SessionUpdate::ToolCallUpdate for that id whose fields set raw_input to the block's complete input (status stays InProgress); emit NOTHING for text/thinking blocks. (4) user messages: for each content block of type tool_result emit a ToolCallUpdate for tool_use_id with status Failed when is_error is true else Completed and a single text content built from `content` (string as is; array of text blocks joined with newlines; anything else empty string). (5) result messages: first, if usage and modelUsage are present and numeric, push a SessionUpdate::UsageUpdate(UsageUpdate::new(used, size)) where used = input_tokens + cache_creation_input_tokens + cache_read_input_tokens + output_tokens (missing parts count 0) and size = contextWindow of the FIRST entry of modelUsage (skip the usage event if size is missing or 0); then set finished = true; ended_aborted = (subtype == "error_during_execution" && terminal_reason == "aborted_streaming"); if is_error is true and not aborted, also push `AcpClientEvent::Error(format!("Claude run failed: {subtype}"))` AFTER the usage event. (6) everything else -> empty mapping

mod.rs gains ONLY the single line `mod claude_sdk_map;` placed with the other non-test `mod` lines (next to `mod catalog;`/`mod client;` style lines in alphabetical position); no test module in this packet; NO other file is edited (tests come in the next packet)

`cargo fmt --check` and `cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets --all-features -- -D warnings` pass; `perl -e 'alarm 600; exec @ARGV' -- cargo nextest run --workspace --no-fail-fast` still reports 0 failures (2573 tests; report the exact counts)

INPUT: Claude Agent SDK messages (serde_json::Value), each already a full JSON object with a top-level "type". Real examples (keys only matter):
 - {"type":"stream_event","event":{"type":"content_block_delta","index":1,"delta":{"type":"text_delta","text":"ok"}},"parent_tool_use_id":null,"session_id":"..."}
 - {"type":"stream_event","event":{"type":"content_block_delta","index":0,"delta":{"type":"thinking_delta","thinking":"..."}}}   (the FIRST thinking_delta often has "thinking":"" -> emit nothing for empty text)
 - {"type":"stream_event","event":{"type":"content_block_delta","index":1,"delta":{"type":"input_json_delta","partial_json":"..."}}}   (ignore)
 - {"type":"stream_event","event":{"type":"content_block_start","index":1,"content_block":{"type":"tool_use","id":"toolu_01D6","name":"Write","input":{}}}}
 - {"type":"assistant","message":{"role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"thinking","thinking":""},{"type":"text","text":"ok"},{"type":"tool_use","id":"toolu_01D6","name":"Write","input":{"file_path":"/x","content":"hi"}}],"stop_reason":null}}   (with includePartialMessages the text/thinking in these were ALREADY streamed as deltas: emit NOTHING for text/thinking blocks, or text would appear twice; only tool_use blocks matter, they carry the complete input)
 - {"type":"user","message":{"role":"user","content":[{"type":"tool_result","tool_use_id":"toolu_01D6","content":"File created...","is_error":false}]},"tool_use_result":{...}}   (`content` is a string OR an array of {"type":"text","text":".."} blocks; `is_error` may be absent)
 - {"type":"user","message":{"role":"user","content":[{"type":"text","text":"[Request interrupted by user]"}]}}   (emit nothing)
 - {"type":"result","subtype":"success","is_error":false,"stop_reason":"end_turn","usage":{"input_tokens":10,"cache_creation_input_tokens":25719,"cache_read_input_tokens":0,"output_tokens":146},"modelUsage":{"claude-haiku-4-5-20251001":{"contextWindow":200000,"maxOutputTokens":32000}},"session_id":"..."}
 - {"type":"result","subtype":"error_during_execution","terminal_reason":"aborted_streaming","is_error":true,...}
 - noise to ignore (empty mapping): "system" (hook_started, hook_response, hook_progress, init, status, session_state_changed, thinking_tokens), "rate_limit_event", "fake_call", anything unknown or malformed.
